info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Loan By Payment Id-spec
info.description: The Loan Payment Update API facilitates the modification of loan payment details using specific identifiers for both the loan and payment. This endpoint allows authorized users, such as financial analysts or customer service representatives, to update pertinent information regarding loan payments, ensuring that records are accurate and up to date. With features to adjust payment statuses or correct payment amounts, this API enhances financial transaction management. Integrating this functionality is essential for applications focused on loan servicing and customer account maintenance.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific payment associated with a loan. You can modify various attributes of the payment based on your requirements, ensuring that the payment records are accurate and up-to-date.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the payment details for the specified loan and payment. It requires a JSON object that contains the necessary fields to modify the payment information.
